passages.title: My Name Is Lan
paragraphs: My name is Lan. I am ten years old. I am a student.
I have a brother and a sister. My brother is Nam. My sister is Hoa. We live in a small house. I love my family.

questions.q: How old is Lan?
questions.why: Bài viết: "I am ten years old."

questions.q: Who is Nam?
questions.why: "My brother is Nam."

questions.q: Lan lives in a big house.
questions.why: Bài viết nói họ sống trong một ngôi nhà nhỏ (small house).

questions.q: Lan has a dog.
questions.why: Bài không nhắc đến con chó.

passages.title: Breakfast at Home
paragraphs: I get up at six. I eat bread and an egg for breakfast. My mother drinks tea. My father drinks coffee. I drink milk.
After breakfast, I go to school by bike.

questions.q: What does the writer drink?
questions.why: "I drink milk."

questions.q: What does the writer's father drink?
questions.why: "My father drinks coffee."

questions.q: The writer goes to school by bus.
questions.why: Bài viết nói người viết đi học bằng xe đạp (by bike).

questions.q: The writer has a sister.
questions.why: Bài không nói về anh chị em.

passages.title: A Day at the Park
paragraphs: On Saturday, Mai and her friends go to the park near her house. The weather is sunny and warm. They play football and talk under a big tree.
At noon, they eat sandwiches and drink water. In the afternoon, it starts to rain, so they run home. Mai is tired but happy.

questions.q: Where do Mai and her friends go?
questions.why: "go to the park near her house"

questions.q: What do they eat at noon?
questions.why: "At noon, they eat sandwiches"

questions.q: It rains in the morning.
questions.why: Trời bắt đầu mưa vào buổi chiều (in the afternoon).

questions.q: Mai takes a camera to the park.
questions.why: Bài không nhắc đến máy ảnh.

questions.q: Why do they run home?
questions.why: "it starts to rain, so they run home" (so = vì vậy).

passages.title: At the Market
paragraphs: Minh goes to the market with his mother every Sunday. They buy fruit, fish and vegetables. Minh likes apples, but his mother likes oranges.
The market is busy and noisy. After shopping, they have a cold drink and walk home.

questions.q: When does Minh go to the market?
questions.why: "every Sunday"

questions.q: What does Minh like?
questions.why: "Minh likes apples"

questions.q: The market is quiet.
questions.why: Chợ "busy and noisy" (đông đúc và ồn ào).

questions.q: They go to the market by car.
questions.why: Bài không nói họ đi bằng gì đến chợ.

questions.q: How do they get home?
questions.why: "walk home"

passages.title: Learning English at the Library
paragraphs: Lan wanted to learn English, so last year she joined a class at her local library. At first she found listening difficult because people spoke too fast.
However, she practised for twenty minutes every evening and watched short videos with subtitles. After six months, she could understand simple conversations.
Now she wants to read English books, but she says that unknown words are still a problem. Her teacher advises her to write them in a notebook and review them every week.

questions.q: Where did Lan join a class?
questions.why: "joined a class at her local library"

questions.q: How long did she practise every evening?
questions.why: "twenty minutes every evening"

questions.q: Lan found listening easy at first.
questions.why: Ban đầu cô thấy nghe khó ("listening difficult").

questions.q: Lan lives abroad.
questions.why: Bài không nói về nơi Lan sống.

questions.q: Why does the teacher suggest a notebook?
options: To help Lan remember new words
questions.answer: To help Lan remember new words
questions.why: Lan gặp vấn đề với từ mới; giáo viên bảo ghi và ôn lại hằng tuần.

questions.q: What can we say about Lan's progress?
questions.why: Sau sáu tháng luyện tập đều đặn, cô hiểu được hội thoại đơn giản.

passages.title: A Weekend in Hue
paragraphs: Last weekend, my family travelled to Hue by train. The journey took about twelve hours, but we enjoyed the views from the window.
On Saturday we visited the old royal city and took many photos. It was very hot, so we drank a lot of water and rested in the shade. On Sunday morning we took a boat on the Perfume River.
Although we were tired, we all agreed that the trip was worth it.

questions.q: How did the family travel to Hue?
questions.why: "travelled to Hue by train"

questions.q: What did they do on Sunday morning?
options: Took a boat on the river
questions.answer: Took a boat on the river
questions.why: "On Sunday morning we took a boat"

questions.q: They visited the royal city on Sunday.
questions.why: Họ thăm thành cổ vào thứ Bảy (Saturday).

questions.q: They stayed in a hotel near the river.
questions.why: Bài không nói về chỗ ở.

questions.q: Why did they rest in the shade?
options: Because the royal city was closed
questions.why: "It was very hot, so we ... rested in the shade."

questions.q: What does "the trip was worth it" suggest?
options: They thought the trip was a good decision
They did not like the trip
questions.answer: They thought the trip was a good decision
questions.why: Dù mệt, mọi người đều đồng ý chuyến đi đáng giá.
